description: Every Auth Core service-token request quarry-edge makes, in one file. It is read by the Rust loader (ServiceTokenRequest::from_manifest in crates/quarry-runtime/src/service_tokens.rs), by the tests that tie each row to its call site and to the request Auth Core really receives, and, as a byte-for-byte vendored copy pinned by the sha256 beside it, by Auth Core's contract spec (QB-T02, CR-T17). A token request that is not a row here cannot be built, and a row with no call site fails the source scan unless it is marked pending. Retention posture is never part of a request: Auth Core selects it from the registry and refuses a request that names one. granted=true means the registry must allow quarry-edge exactly this audience and these scopes. granted=false means this row is not open to its callers today and every caller of the row degrades: the registry refuses the request, or (the three rows model-invoke, model-stream and model-audio, since the WS16.S2 grant gave quarry-edge the model-gateway audience for the two model-extract rows) it authorizes the same audience and scopes as a granted row and the closed gate is Quarry's own. Flipping the field is then the only manifest change a grant needs. To change a row: edit this file, refresh cross-plane-token-requests.json.sha256, update the digest registered in scripts/tests/zdr-contract-sync.test.sh and re-vendor the copies listed there.

rows.name: vector-retrieve
rows.notes: Vector leg of hybrid search: POST /v1/retrieve on the Data Plane retrieval engine. Read-only. It never carries org:data:read_all: that scope marks a system write and belongs to the ingest row alone.

rows.name: ingest
rows.notes: Persistence of crawled pages: POST /v1/documents on the Data Plane. org:data:read_all marks a system ingest, so documents-api stamps crawled pages visibility=org; without it they land private to service:quarry-edge and no user sees them. Never requested for a ZDR run.

rows.name: web-rerank
rows.notes: Rerank of caller-supplied web candidates: POST /v1/rerank on the Data Plane (paid Azure Cohere). A request of its own on purpose: no other scope rides with data:rerank and no other row holds it. Never audience model-gateway: reranking uses neither the Model Plane nor a subscription. The grant of data:rerank to quarry-edge on data-plane is in the checked-in Control Plane registry (apps/Control Plane/config/plane-service-principals.json, principal bundle P1, QB-T01), so the source is complete; Auth Core refuses this mint until that bundle is live in auth-service, and until then the search keeps its lexical order. apps/Data Plane v2/scripts/qb-preflight.sh --live --ship-qb-t09 checks the live grant and the Data Plane gate before QB-T09 ships.

rows.name: model-invoke
rows.notes: Model Plane POST /v1/invoke, used by intent classification, autoprompt, the semantic reranker, page titles, ai-formats and answer synthesis. Since the WS16.S2 grant the registry gives quarry-edge the model-gateway audience with models:invoke for the model-extract row, and Auth Core cannot tell this request from that one (same audience, same scope): the closed gate is Quarry's (model_plane_gate keeps every feature of this row off) and the gateway, which refuses a service principal on /v1/invoke. Each caller degrades (decision D16, owned by QB-T17). Flip granted only together with a decision to open these callers.

rows.name: model-stream
rows.notes: Model Plane POST /v1/invoke/stream, used by streamed answers and ai-formats. Closed today for the same reason as model-invoke: a Quarry-side gate, not an Auth Core refusal (D16, QB-T17).

rows.name: model-audio
rows.notes: POST /v1/audio, forwarded to /v1/ai/speech and /v1/ai/transcribe. Closed today for the same reason as model-invoke: a Quarry-side gate, not an Auth Core refusal (D16, QB-T17).

rows.name: browser-grant-validate
rows.notes: The BrowserBroker ValidateGrant call for the run's grant, made on behalf of the run's verified organization (X-1, WS1.A2): a token minted for that org makes the broker look the grant up in that org, so another org's grant is not found. Scope browser:read only: acquire, revoke and derive-run need browser:write, which no principal holds. The registry lane is ZDR (validation carries no content); the request never names a retention.

rows.name: model-extract
rows.reason: extract structured data from page text
rows.notes: The first of the two tokens an AI format needs: the user-ingress bearer of POST /v1/ai/chat, minted for the verified org. WS16.S2 granted quarry-edge the model-gateway audience with models:invoke at tenant retention (the token's zdr is the org's own posture, resolved by Auth Core). It is a request of its own, never combined with a data-plane scope. It is granted together with model-extract-inference and the AI-formats gate needs both rows; model-invoke, model-stream and model-audio stay granted:false, a Quarry-side gate.

rows.name: model-extract-inference
rows.reason: authorize inference for structured page extraction
rows.notes: The second token an AI format needs: the x-inference-authorization bearer of POST /v1/ai/chat, aud inference-core, minted for the verified org. WS16.S2 granted quarry-edge the inference-core audience with inference:invoke and models:invoke at tenant retention. Never held by a data-plane request.

rows.name: mail-otp-read
rows.notes: The executor-only one-time-code read (E3.1-h, ADR-2a): integration-corev2 POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/actions with operation mail.otp.read, minted for the run's verified org. R-13 PR 1 granted quarry-edge the ingestion audience with integration:otp:read alone, as a ZDR lane; no other row holds the scope and no other scope rides with it. integration-core refuses the shared internal key and any token without this scope for the operation, and quarry-edge is not a token lease consumer. The read is reachable only behind QUARRY_EDGE__FILL_OTP (default off, read by otp_source::fill_otp_enabled, not an edge config field) and one approved fill_otp grant per read (the edge's single-use set plus the client's own spent set). The code never reaches a log, an error or a receipt.

rows.name: office-extract
rows.reason: ephemeral text extraction of a fetched Office file
rows.notes: The bearer of imports-core POST /api/v1/import/extract (E3.6-6a/6b), minted for the run's verified organization. The registry lane is ZDR: the extraction is ephemeral and nothing is stored, embedded or sent on, so the token carries imports:read alone and imports-core admits imports:read for exactly that one POST (every other non-GET route there still needs imports:write). It is reachable only behind QUARRY_EDGE__OFFICE_VIA_IMPORTS (default off, read by pipeline::office_via_imports_mode, not an edge config field) and QUARRY_EDGE__DOC_ROUTING. Built by ManifestImportsBearer::for_office_extract; no other row holds imports:read.

rows.name: artifacts-read
rows.reason: no_egress scrape reads the org's stored page capture
rows.notes: The no_egress scrape read of one stored page capture: POST /v1/artifacts/lookup on the Data Plane (E3.8.8), minted for the run's verified organization. Read-only, the same audience and scope as vector-retrieve but a request of its own so the artifact read is named at its call site; it never carries org:data:read_all. Reachable only behind QUARRY_EDGE__NO_EGRESS (default off, read by fetch::no_egress_enabled, not an edge config field), and never requested for a ZDR run: the no_egress driver refuses a ZDR caller before any lookup. Built by DataPlaneArtifactReader::with_manifest_token_request.
